title: Combined v2: c002 + the full 4,495-target RL pool + compacting, Lean-overlapped RL sampler
description: Same 192k RL samples as c002 but spread over every rl_targets theorem instead of the harness's seeded 1,500 (c002 solved 87% of those, so late rounds re-solved known targets); the queue covers the pool once in ~11 rounds, then refills hardest-first. RL sampling drops finished rows from the batch and checks each chunk in Lean while the next decodes (same distribution; eval unchanged).
hypothesis: Transfer to dev comes from the breadth of theorems the policy has learned to prove; c002 saturated its 1,500 targets (1,273-1,308 solved), so the same samples over 3x more distinct theorems add more new training proofs per round and more transferable skill.
expected_delta: +0 to +50 over c002; RL rounds ~25-35% faster (samples/s up from ~180)

pretrain.arch: ALiBiGPT 6x384 Peri-LN, 8 heads (4 ALiBi + 4 NoPE), d_ff 1280

config.data: fork 51604b3: train.jsonl cap-6 (retention), 1,500 rl_targets sampled with the harness seed, dev half of transfer (1,108) for eval
config.eval: frozen harness stage_eval: EVAL_K 64, T 0.8, max_new 512; metric = dev solved at L_true >= 7

rl.targets: all 4,495 rl_targets (full pool, shuffled with the harness seed)
rl.sampler: fast_sample.generate: compaction + Lean gate overlapped with decoding (RL only; eval = frozen harness sampler)
